Small status label for categorization or state indication.

Badges are outlined: no fill, with a 1px border in the same colour as the text. They take the surface
colour behind them, so the text colour must contrast with that surface (at least 4.5:1).

A bare text node * becomes an anonymous flex item, and some browsers (notably Safari) report its unaligned position from * Range.getBoundingClientRect, which put the knockout text off-centre next to taller icons. */ .label[hidden] { display: none; } button.knockout { color: transparent; } button.knockout::before { -webkit-mask: var(--_knockout-mask) 0 0 / 100% 100% no-repeat; mask: var(--_knockout-mask) 0 0 / 100% 100% no-repeat; } @media (forced-colors: active) { button.knockout { color: ButtonText; } button.knockout::before { -webkit-mask: none; mask: none; } } button:focus-visible { outline: none; } ${variantStyles('primary', ['[variant="primary"]', ':not([variant])'])} ${variantStyles('secondary', ['[variant="secondary"]'])} ${variantStyles('danger', ['[variant="danger"]'])} ${variantStyles('ghost', ['[variant="ghost"]'])} /* === SIZES === */ :host([size='sm']) button { font-size: var(--kds-font-size-100); --_padding-y: var(--kds-size-100-rem); --_padding-x: var(--kds-size-300-rem); } :host([size='lg']) button { font-size: var(--kds-font-size-300); --_padding-y: var(--kds-size-300-rem); --_padding-x: var(--kds-size-600-rem); } `

attributes.name: on-inverse

declarations.summary:
Trigger actions or navigate. Always use this instead of a native <button> with manual styling.

Solid variants (`primary`, `secondary`, `danger`) render the label and icons as a knockout: they are
cut out of the button fill, so the surface behind the button shows through. The surface behind the
button must therefore have good contrast (at least 4.5:1) with the button fill in every state.
On inverse surfaces (`semantic.bg.inverse`), set `on-inverse` to switch to the fills made for them.

declarations.summary:
Surface container for grouping related content.

Cards have a 1px border and a crisp, unblurred offset shadow. There are no divider lines: header,
body and footer are separated by spacing only.
